title: Policy Maps: Tools for Guiding the Unbounded Space of LLM Behaviors
benchmark_measurement: The paper did not specifically measure any aspects of faith or religion. One user-created policy during the study made a distinction between racial slurs and religious slurs, but this was not a focus of the evaluation.
findings: The paper did not produce findings related to religion, as it was not a focus of the research. The study centered on creating a general tool and process for LLM policy design across various safety domains.
